email_body:
Dear Qargo Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the UI/UX Designer position at Qargo, as advertised. With a strong foundation in UI design, front-end development, and a passion for creating intuitive, accessible interfaces, I am excited about the opportunity to own and evolve your design system from the ground up.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in building and maintaining WordPress sites, focusing on responsive design and user experience. My previous experience as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor involved developing features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript, where I gained a deep understanding of front-end technologies and the importance of clean, consistent UI.

I am proficient in Figma and have a working knowledge of HTML/CSS, which I believe will enable me to collaborate effectively with your engineering team. I am comfortable working directly with customers and am eager to bring my proactive, ownership-driven approach to your product trios.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am fluent in English. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with Qargo's needs.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the UI/UX Designer position at Qargo. As a designer with a strong technical background and a keen eye for clean, consistent UI, I am drawn to the opportunity to own and evolve a design system from the ground up—a challenge that aligns perfectly with my skills and career aspirations.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have been responsible for building and maintaining client websites in WordPress, where I focus on responsive design and user experience. This hands-on experience has taught me the importance of clarity, hierarchy, and consistency in interface design. Previously, as a Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor, I developed and optimized features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript, giving me a solid understanding of front-end technologies and the ability to bridge the gap between design and code.

I am highly proficient in Figma and have a working knowledge of HTML/CSS, which I believe will enable me to collaborate effectively with your engineering team. I am comfortable using AI tools to streamline design and prototyping workflows, and I am eager to apply these skills to help Qargo's design system become a robust foundation for your product.

What excites me most about this role is the direct customer contact and the chance to work as part of product trios. I am proactive, quick to understand new domains, and thrive on taking ownership of design improvements. I am also fluent in English and based in Zwijndrecht, making Ghent easily accessible.

I am eager to bring my UI design expertise and collaborative spirit to Qargo and help shape the visual experience of your Transport Management System. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
